page0.text:
Charge. Halt. Attack.
Having repelled all of Caster's Divine Words, Saber concluded the match without any opening for a counterattack.
The speed at which she charges, the force of her planted feet, and the horizontal line her sword draws brings an unavoidable strike.
She swings her invisible sword at the enemy Master.
A perfectly timed attack.
With a slash so satisfying that it would sever a large tree, Saber splits Souichirou Kuzuki in twain.

page1.text: No... It should have split him in two.

page2.text:
"Wha..."
She gasps in bewilderment.
Her eyes must be playing tricks.
Saber stares at the enemy before her in astonishment, still mid-swing.

page3.text:
"...Imposs...ible..."
Comprehension eludes her.
The fatal attack cut a perfect line.
That attack is stopped.
Just shy of the enemy's body, the sword was caught between...

page4.text:
"...His leg and...arm?"
Is such a miracle possible?
Her sword has been stopped by her enemy, Souichirou Kuzuki.
Between raised knee and cocked elbow.
The man stopped her high-speed slash by catching it in between his elbow and knee.

page5.text:
...
Of course, she is unaware...
There is an Eastern martial arts technique that is used to catch an opponent's weapon with one's bare hands, and there are experts today who still practice it.
Even then, she wouldn't have stood there with naked amazement had it been a normal battle.

page6.text:
But this is a Servant battle.
And the enemy is just a human.
But to stop a fatal attack from a sword blade that cannot be seen with his bare hands...there is no way this man could possibly be sane!

page7.text:
"...You underestimated me, Saber."
His voice is deep, as if echoing from the depths of the earth.
"...Nnng!!!"
Saber's body moves.
She tries to pull back her sword with all her might.

page8.text:
And in that instant...
"Guh...!?"
A sudden surprise blow strikes the back of her head.

page9.text:
"Huh...!?"
She doesn't understand what is going on at all.
It is her first time fighting someone who can stop a sword without any arms or armor at all.
Wait, was that attack done by his bare hands as well?
She must have been punched. The back of her head was struck at such close range she could feel her opponent's very breath?

page10.text:
"Guh...!"
She avoids it, without knowing what it is.
"Ugh...!"
Something grazes her temple.
Saber perceives that it is a fist Strengthened by some kind of magecraft and leaps back.

page11.text:
As she wields a long weapon, she is at a disadvantage at close range against an unarmed opponent.
Saber retreats to a range where she can make use of her sword.

page12.text:
She faces the enemy the entire time.
Her only goal is to move out of the range advantageous to her opponent.
It is a basic, established tactic to pursue a retreating target.
But he does not give chase.
Though he will be defeated if he remains stationary, Caster's Master does not move—
He strikes her at the solar plexus.

page13.text:
"Guh...!?"
The wind is knocked out of her.
She feels the impact.
The attack is hindered by her armor, which keeps the blow from piercing her body.

page14.text:
"Hrrk, ugh...!"
The impacts continue.
They are nothing more than human fists that precisely target her vital areas.

page15.text:
...
Could she even comprehend in time?
By the time she realized that those stone-like fingers were the cause of impact, the match had already been decided.
The rain of fists repeat.
His fists are fired in rapid succession, with an intensity and weight as if they are made of divine iron.

page16.text:
How can it be explained?
His arms are flexible like a whip but only move at right angles.
If his arms are shot out in a flash, the way his forearms follow are the technique of a demon.

page17.text:
"Hnng... Guh...!?"
The barely perceptible blows target all of her vitals.
He allows no counterattack.
Even her arms are targeted, and that pain reaches her core even through her armor.

page18.text:
The attacks all come from the outside and shift inside.
A wide swing of the arm changes direction using the elbow as the fulcrum, attacking Saber from all directions.

page19.text:
"Hnng... Khh...!"
The attacks are keen and cause dulling.
Though not an instant death, each blow contributes to a slow-acting poison.
That is the death that seeps in with each blow.
Each blow cannot be avoided, and each strike alone is not enough to maim.
But...the pain numbs her mind each time.
And with the opening from that, his fist seeks the back of her head once again, like the curling cull of Death's scythe.

page20.text:
"Guh...!"
Intuition allows her to avoid it.
The attacks going for her arms or chest are fine.
But if the back of her head is struck, she's done for.
And so Saber concentrates her muddied mind on that one blow.
He is a beast that can block her sword empty-handed.
Intuition alone gives her the insight necessary to face this unknown style that she has never faced the likes of.

page21.text:
"...You dodge them quite well. Even though you are still confused."
The enemy's arm stops.
His stance is like his fists, firm like rock.

page22.text:
"...I see. It is not your eyes that are good, but your instinct."
"...!"
The man's body moves.
What was different about this attack?
Saber, able to avoid all fatal blows up until this point, could not evade the next blow.

page23.text:
"Hrrk..."
Her consciousness fades.
The impact landing on the back of her head shakes her brain.
"Khh...!"
Even then, she raises both arms.
The man's attack cannot penetrate her armor.
Then...the man will go for her unprotected face.

page24.text:
Saber raises both arms and protects her own face.
"Guh...!"
The impact weaves past her limbs.
It is like a snake that crawls through a dense forest.
The enemy's fists expertly makes its way through her upraised arms.

page25.text:
"Hnng... Khh...!"
Her consciousness drifts.
The body of the metaphorical snake, his left elbow, hammers into her collarbone.

page26.text:
Saber avoids it by retreating a short distance and adjusts the grip on her sword.
The course of the fist after that...
She prepares for the blow coming from the left that will change direction at the elbow and aim at the back of her head.
She cannot afford to make light of him.
If her opponent demands her consciousness, then so be it.
In return, she will claim his arms. She opens her eyes...
And is astonished by the change.

page27.text:
...
Using his elbow as the fulcrum, the blow comes straight down from above.
The circular orbit of attacks up until now change to a straight line!

page28.text:
"...Guh...!!!"
She immediately moves her neck to avoid the blow going for the top of her head.
"Hrrk...!"
The impact falls on her shoulder.
As she glares at the enemy for wrecking her shoulder, a freezing sensation shoots down her spine.

page29.text:
The man cocks his upper body.
His right arm, still this entire time, finally moves.
At the height of her throat, his arm is released like a cannonball.

page30.text:
...
Unlike the previous attack following a downward line, this jab comes straight in like a thrust.
His fist flies at Saber.
With such force and precision, it will skewer her.
The blow comes with all of his might and will easily pierce her throat, sever bone, and rip her head off...!

page31.text:
"Hnn!!!"
But it misses.
Surprise attacks don't work on her; intuition like seeing the future is hers to command.
The snake's fist grazes past her neck.
Seeing that, she steps in to attack, but at that moment—
Right beside her neck...
An unbelievable sound.

page32.text:
The snake's fang pierces her.
The instant Saber avoids his fist, his fingers grab her with a sickening crunch.
"...Like an anchor b—!"
The astonishment passes through her as a shudder.
Yes, a hand is usually something used to grab, not punch.
He must be receiving aid from Caster's magecraft, as his fingers easily crush Saber's neck...!

page33.text:
"Guh... Ahhh...!!!"
Saber raises her sword.
She swings to cut off the enemy's arm before her neck is crushed.

page34.text:
But she is unable to finish her attack.
Before she can bring her sword down, her entire body is swung like a sword in his hands.
She feels herself fly through the air.
He swings like a baseball pitcher.
While still holding Saber's neck, the man throws her with one arm.
